name: MedicalInformationRequestDesk
tagline: Answer every medical information enquiry on time – with AE and complaint hand-offs you can prove.
description: A complete Medical Affairs app for Power Apps and Power Pages: log unsolicited enquiries from HCPs, patients and payers, screen every request for adverse events and product complaints with mandatory hand-off references, answer from a pre-approved standard response letter library or route custom and off-label answers through four-eyes medical review, and track the SLA in working days from a dashboard, drag-and-drop work queue and searchable register.
features: Mandatory AE / product-complaint screening with PV and complaint references
Hand-off deadline in working days with overdue alerts
SLA per priority in working days, paused while waiting for the requester
Standard response letter library with expiry, usage and topic-gap analysis
Off-label: unsolicited confirmation, mandatory medical review, refer-to-HCP for patients
Drag-and-drop work queue with next-step buttons
Search, 10 quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export
Undo for every change and a time-stamped history
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
